what: On each of three overlapping large circles (orbit, 1px border), a small circle (orbiter) travels once around the inner edge in 10s linear (each circle has its own start angle --fx-from and direction --fx-turn, and the text counter-rotates to stay upright). Each press on the panel advances to the next turn: that turn’s small circle darkens (.4s, the others become a pale color mixed 70% with the background), the title word changes from .3 to 1 (.4s), and the description (item) changes in the overlapped spot .2s later over .4s. On change it fires fx:pick(detail.index), and on receiving fx:go(detail.index) it jumps to that turn, which interlocks with the carousel on phone
